<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="1201">

This message is generated when the severity of an exception is edited to be different from the current value in Settings Manager \> Application \> [Exception Description Editor](../../Settings%20Manager/Application/Exception%20Description%20Editor.md).

- Date 1 Usage: Exception Number
- Data 2 Usage: Old Value
- Data 3 Usage: New Value
- Message Class: 3 (Information)
- Message Priority: 5 (Logged)
